instructions.question: Does the text in `mention.text` refer to the removed thing described in `removed`?

true.what: The mention is about the removed thing itself: it uses one of the names in `removed.names`, or describes behavior, configuration or interfaces the removed thing had, as described in `removed.description`.
true.not_for: A different thing that happens to share a word with a name, such as an unrelated function of the same name in another module.

false.what: The mention is about something else entirely, and none of the names in `removed.names` appears as a name of the removed thing in the text.

instructions.question: Would an agent reading `mention.text` be led to use, call, configure or re-create the removed thing described in `removed`?

true.what: The mention instructs use: it shows how to call or configure the thing, presents it as current or recommended, gives an example to copy, asserts a behavior of it, or is a test that exercises it.

false.what: The mention only records history or absence: a changelog entry, a migration or deprecation note, a decision record, or prose that says the thing is gone.
false.not_for: Prose that presents the thing as usable, even inside a document that also mentions its removal.

intended_uses.refers_to_removed: Separate the removed thing's real mentions from same-word different-thing matches, so the caller only acts on real residues.
intended_uses.leads_agent_to_recreate: Rank which real mentions would make an agent bring the removed thing back, versus harmless historical prose.

workflow.purpose: After a function, feature or banned pattern is removed, find every residual mention in the repository that could resurrect it; the calling agent fixes or reviews the flagged mentions.
workflow.consumer_code: if refers.verdict == YES and kind in (agent_docs, test) and leads.verdict == YES: action = 'resurrection'; elif refers.verdict == YES and kind in (source, comment): action = 'fix_reference'; elif refers.verdict == YES: action = 'historical'; elif refers.verdict == NO: action = 'unrelated'; else: action = 'review'  # unsure stays visible, never silently dropped
